d:
The physicality is picking up. Relive the hardest checks and biggest collisions from Week 3 and Week 4 of the 2026-27 NHL season, with exclusive camera angles and natural sound putting you right on top of the impact.
Jake Neighbours catches Tim Stützle with a thunderous check, J.T. Miller delivers a devastating reverse hit, Mikko Rantanen dishes out punishment, Hunter McDonald makes his physical presence felt for Philadelphia, Nikita Zadorov sends a rookie flying and Rasmus Dahlin delivers a hit you'll feel all day long.
Turn it up and FEEL THE HIT.
